headline: Executive order addressing how independent federal regulatory agencies make and review their rules.
what_it_does: This order deals with independent regulatory agencies, which are federal agencies that operate with more separation from the President than regular departments. Based on its title, it addresses how these agencies write and manage regulations. It is generally understood to encourage these agencies to follow the same rulemaking principles set for other agencies and to plan regular reviews of their existing rules. No official summary was provided, so details are limited.

who_it_affects.how: The order sets out expectations for how these agencies create and review their rules.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals covered by those agencies' rules
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes if agencies review, update, or remove existing regulations.
